claim: Fixed automation systems such as conveyors and shuttles cost EUR 2-8M and take 12-18 months to install.
Annual labor churn in European logistics hubs exceeds 40%.
Aquilon's robots map a warehouse autonomously on day one and can be deployed in under two weeks.
The current robot generation carries a 35 kg payload, uses an 8-hour swappable battery, and travels at 1.6 m/s.
Aquilon was named Intralogistics Robot of the Year 2025 by the European Warehouse Automation Council.
Pilot fleets total 41 robots moving roughly 9,000 totes per day combined.
Average pilot contract value is EUR 11,500 per month.
Two pilot customers have converted to 24-month expansion agreements.
Net revenue retention across converted accounts is 138%.
Letters of intent are signed for 4 additional sites representing EUR 610k ARR.
There are 38,000 mid-size warehouses across the EU and UK.
The warehouse-automation market for mid-size sites will grow at a 17% CAGR from 2025 to 2030.
The CTO has 11 years of experience in mobile-robot SLAM and multi-agent path planning.
Current ARR is EUR 292k with a monthly burn of EUR 145k and 7 months of runway.
A robotics-as-a-service model priced per robot plus per tote aligns vendor incentives with customer throughput.
If two of six pilots convert to multi-year agreements, the product has demonstrated repeatable value in production settings.
A EUR 3.5M seed round is an appropriate amount for this stage and plan.
Gross margin at pilot volumes is 31% against a target of 58% at scale.
